intent: One agent tool call on one line: status, mono name, summary and a live timer. Opens to arguments and result; with calls it rolls several calls into one group row.
useWhen: show each tool an agent calls in a chat or a run log
let people inspect a call's arguments and result
roll a burst of calls into one row ("Ran 4 tools")
doNotUseWhen: a step list for a whole task — AgentTrail
a call that needs the person's OK first — ApprovalCard

name.note: Tool name in mono, e.g. "search_files". Required unless calls is set.

summary.note: One line: query, target or outcome. Truncates.

startedAt.note: Epoch ms. A running call ticks a live timer from it.

args.note: Object → pretty JSON; string → as is.

error.note: Error lines; an error card opens by default.

onRetry.note: Shows Retry (outline) in the open panel.

calls.note: Group mode: { id, name, summary?, status, duration? }[]. Header sums done / running / failed.

requirements: the header is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls when there is detail
status is named in text for screen readers; icons are aria-hidden
the live timer does not announce (aria-live off)
spinner and open motion use transform and opacity, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local ToolCall, ToolRow, or FunctionCallCard
Do not paraphrase arguments; show them
Do not put an approval in a tool call; use ApprovalCard
Do not use raw hex for status colors
snippet: <ToolCallCard name="search_files" summary="3 matches in 2 files" status="done" duration="0.9s" args={{ query: "invoice total", path: "src/billing" }} result={["invoice.ts:41 return subtotal * (1 + rate);"]} />
